target: PTDE-visible material/resource routing on DSR host
scope: static FLVER owner-slot material semantics; not pixel equivalence

runtime_policy.activation: HOLD_OFF positive Diffuse/Normal authorization until an exact DSR (FLVER identity, material slot, MTD) owner-tuple corpus is materialized and runtime-authenticated
runtime_policy.mixed_usage: evaluate per semantic bit; unstable bit fails open
runtime_policy.other_operators: unchanged; EnvSpec/SpecRGB/Subsurface/PointLight retain independently certified routes
runtime_policy.aggregate_evidence: MTD-level shared-stable resource evidence is a negative/refinement constraint only; it cannot authenticate a caller-supplied owner tuple
runtime_policy.negative_spx_evidence: exact MTD/SPX DSR-only lane evidence may conservatively suppress that lane without positive owner authentication
